answer: Sybil resistance binds each identity to bonded collateral in an escrow: when k identities coordinate an equivocation, correlated penalties scale as O(k^2), while detection applies an exponential-in-k multiplier to the swarm’s capital loss through asymmetric depreciation. Thus velvet credentials, a plume of aliases, or a relic stake cannot cheaply amplify influence; one coordinated failure makes concealment economically irrational.
